4067-5078-7914-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Repeat

2393-2738-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

6215-7918.description:
At the beginning of each upkeep, Tombostone Stairwell's first ability triggers, causing each player to create a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature card in their graveyard.
At the beginning of each end step, Tombstone Stairwell's second ability triggers, destroying all tokens created by it.
When the token(s) die, Sifa Grent triggers that many times, causing an opponent to lose that much life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat during each turn.

3490-3910-4017-5296-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
3490-3910-4017-5296-7824.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1263-4556-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

1251-2105-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

2292-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
2292-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2292-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5223-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1477-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1477-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-4657-7288.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-4657-7288.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers twice, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

333-2034-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4716-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4716-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

30-147-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-2438.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-2438.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

888-2751-3649.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
888-2751-3649.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Strionic Resonator's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Strionic Resonator triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

1669-3293-4826-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1669-3293-4826-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1669-3293-4826-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2829-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.

224-3257-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

570-1418-2608--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
570-1418-2608--108.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Holding priority, activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-1418-2608--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

513-2103-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
513-2103-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
513-2103-6333.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5147-5263-6243.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

710-1052-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-1770-4124-5478-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-501-586-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2079-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2079-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

2921-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2921-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

647-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
647-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

920-1987-3277-5195.description:
Activate Kaza by tapping it, causing the next instant or sorcery spell you cast to cost at least {2} less.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch and Kaza.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Kaza and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

722-3153-4284.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Clone each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

507-3741.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a spell that shares a type with the exiled spell, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast the spell, Void Mirror triggers, countering that spell since no colored mana was spent to cast it.

751-1671-3314-3875.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

813-2104-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
813-2104-3742.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages that is tapped and attacking.
Scholar of the Ages enters, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2510-4125.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1283-1987-2510-4125.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
